findings.evidence: Observed 180 sessions across 37 weekly blocks (clears 60-session / 20-week floor). Gross Sharpe 3.09, 90% bootstrap CI [1.09, 5.48].
findings.why_it_matters: Provides sufficient time-series degrees of freedom to evaluate regime stability and cost drag.
findings.next_experiment: Proceed to multi-seed paired comparison against the live champion (`tournament.submit`).
findings.limitation: Single-path historical depth does not account for unrecorded parameter trials (Deflated Sharpe).

findings.finding: Pessimistic Execution Cost & Slippage Stress Survival
findings.evidence: Gross edge of 39.68 bps/trade survives 1.0x (15.00 bps -> net +24.68 bps) and 2.0x pessimistic cost stress (30.00 bps -> net +9.68 bps; breakeven multiplier: 2.65x; net Sharpe: 2.16).
findings.why_it_matters: Confirms a structural buffer above realistic bid-ask spread, slippage, and adverse selection.
findings.next_experiment: Verify liquidity capacity on target symbols using `market.microstructure` before scaling notional.
findings.limitation: Based on declared/house bps parameters; borrow fees for short legs are not included.

findings.evidence: Max drawdown contained at 3.13% (worst 5-session return: -2.18%); positive mean return in both calm (+15.65 bps/day) and elevated-volatility (+7.49 bps/day) windows.
findings.why_it_matters: Demonstrates controlled tail excursion and positive expectancy across volatility environments.
findings.next_experiment: Verify worst-regime margin across all 5 canonical regimes via `gym.probe_fragility`.
findings.limitation: Close-to-close series does not capture intraday stop-out slippage.

findings.finding: Trade Outlier Concentration & House Position Cap Compliance
findings.evidence: Across 45 trades, top-5 trades account for 15.2% of gross gains (well below 45% threshold) and max single-position size is 16.0% (0 breaches of the 25% house floor).
findings.why_it_matters: Confirms broad-based trade breadth and full compliance with live-capital position sizing invariants.
findings.next_experiment: Validate multi-asset rebalance trade lists using `warden.plan_rebalance`.
findings.limitation: Assumes trade timestamps reflect actual execution fill times.

findings.evidence: All 3 declared feature(s) passed point-in-time timestamp checks (`available_at <= as_of`), zero banned actuals sources, and coverage >= 90%.
findings.why_it_matters: Verifies declared feature inputs are causally knowable at decision time.
findings.next_experiment: Cross-check cross-sectional IC significance on alternative-data features with `pit.analysis`.
findings.limitation: Validates the feature manifest contract; does not verify internal code implementation.

findings.evidence: Matched 180 overlapping sessions vs benchmark; annualized active return is 2754.4 bps with Information Ratio 1.72.
findings.why_it_matters: Separates genuine active edge from passive market beta exposure.
findings.next_experiment: Verify active return stability across drawdown and chop regimes (`gym.paired_preview`).
findings.limitation: Linear benchmark subtraction does not capture nonlinear tail beta.

findings.finding: Underlying Strategy Code & Multiple-Testing Trial Ledger Boundary
findings.evidence: Tabular artifact audit only — strategy source code and discarded trial count were not evaluated locally.
findings.why_it_matters: Even a clean return series and manifest cannot prove that 500 parameter combinations were not swept behind the scenes to find one lucky backtest.
findings.next_experiment: Submit the candidate genome to the hosted Shadow Tournament (`tournament.submit`) for paired replay against the live champion and Deflated Sharpe ratio accounting.
